snippet.title: A Simple Ball Game - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to roll! ... or fall. Yeah, probably fall. 
A Simple Ball Game is coming in 2025!

Take on a gauntlet of unreasonably difficult stages one after another in this smooth and spherical platformer. No need to worry though, it's just a simple ball game.

--

The Demo for A Simple Ball Game goes live 2.11.2025.

Wishlist A Simple Ball Game today to get notified on release!
Steam: https://pajamatown.net/a-simple-ball-game/wishlist
